_meta.status: PLACEHOLDER. Order-of-magnitude US national averages compiled from general industry knowledge, without access to a cost database or current bids. Verify with an estimator (or RSMeans / local subcontractor pricing) before relying on cost rankings.
_meta.basis: Installed cost: material + fabrication + labor + equipment + subcontractor overhead and profit. Excludes general contractor markups, design contingency, escalation, sales tax, fireproofing, connections beyond typical shear tabs, lateral system and foundations.
_meta.ton: US short ton (2,000 lb). The bay study gives steel, rebar and PT in lb per sq ft of floor: tons per sq ft = psf / 2000.
_meta.systems_covered: Steel (STL_COMP, STL_ROOF_W, STL_ROOF_J). Concrete and mass timber rates added for spec 6, prompt 8 (decisions log); how each DB quantity maps to a rate is settled when those systems are built.

wide_flange_framing_usd_per_ton.applies_to: W-shape beams and girders (STL_COMP, STL_ROOF_W) and the W girders of STL_ROOF_J
wide_flange_framing_usd_per_ton.note: Fabricated and erected, typical simple shear connections

columns_usd_per_ton.applies_to: W12/W14 gravity columns sized by columns.py
columns_usd_per_ton.note: Includes an allowance for base plates and splices

shear_studs_usd_each.note: 3/4 in. diameter, field welded through deck

composite_floor_deck_usd_per_sf.note: Gauge not stated in the bay study; priced as typical 20 ga

concrete_on_deck_usd_per_cy.note: 4 ksi normal weight, pumped, placed, finished and cured

slab_reinforcing_on_deck_usd_per_sf.applies_to: STL_COMP slab (the bay study reports no slab reinforcing)
slab_reinforcing_on_deck_usd_per_sf.note: Welded wire reinforcement or light temperature/shrinkage bars

roof_deck_usd_per_sf.note: Rows with a blank gauge in the bay study (e.g. '1.5B  ga roof deck') are priced at the 18 ga rate (conservative)

structural_concrete_usd_per_cy.applies_to: Cast-in-place slab, beam and joist concrete (DB concrete_cy_per_sf)
structural_concrete_usd_per_cy.note: 5 ksi normal weight, pumped, placed, finished and cured; formwork and reinforcing priced separately

formwork_flat_plate_usd_per_sf.applies_to: CONC_RC_FP and CONC_PT_FP slab soffit, per sq ft of floor
formwork_flat_plate_usd_per_sf.note: Flying or table forms, multiple reuses

formwork_one_way_slab_beam_usd_per_sf.applies_to: CONC_OW_PTB slab and beams, per sq ft of floor

formwork_pan_joist_usd_per_sf.applies_to: CONC_PAN pans, joist and beam forms, per sq ft of floor
formwork_pan_joist_usd_per_sf.note: Rented pans; standard or wide module

rebar_usd_per_ton.applies_to: Mild reinforcing in slabs, beams and joists (DB rebar_psf), and concrete columns

pt_strand_usd_per_lb.applies_to: Post-tensioning (DB pt_psf, lb per sq ft)
pt_strand_usd_per_lb.note: Unbonded 0.5 in. monostrand, installed and stressed, including anchors

stud_rails_usd_per_sf.applies_to: Flat plate rows with stud rails (DB shear_studs = 'Yes'), per sq ft of floor
stud_rails_usd_per_sf.note: Allowance: the bay study gives no rail count

column_formwork_usd_per_sfca.applies_to: Square concrete columns sized by columns.py, per sq ft of contact area
column_formwork_usd_per_sfca.note: Column concrete is priced at structural_concrete_usd_per_cy and column bars at rebar_usd_per_ton

glulam_framing_usd_per_bf.applies_to: Glulam beams and girders (DB timber_bf_per_sf, board feet)
glulam_framing_usd_per_bf.note: Fabricated (CNC) and erected, including typical concealed connections; about $3,000 per cubic meter

glulam_columns_usd_per_bf.applies_to: Square glulam columns sized by columns.py
glulam_columns_usd_per_bf.note: Includes base and cap connection allowance

clt_panels_usd_per_cf.applies_to: CLT floor and roof panels (DB clt_thickness_in x floor area)
clt_panels_usd_per_cf.note: Supplied and installed; 5-ply (about 6.9 in.) is about $26 per sq ft of floor

concrete_topping_usd_per_sf.applies_to: MT_FLOOR 3 in. concrete topping, per sq ft of floor
concrete_topping_usd_per_sf.note: Concrete, welded wire mesh, pumping and finishing; acoustic mat excluded
